tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Poppy wants to talk about class display. which picture to use. what colour to add. when to finish.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Poppy.

promptBlocks.subject: Class display
paragraphs: I am writing about class display. which picture to use? what colour to add?
when to finish? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Poppy and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Poppy solves it and finishes happily.
